answer_1.quote: We explore multi-task learning (MTL) to boost ETR generation by combining summarization and simplification ... we introduce ETR-fr, the first dataset of 523 paragraph-aligned text pairs fully compliant with the European ETR guidelines.

answer_2.quote: The evaluation framework combines standard automatic metrics with detailed human assessment based on a 38-point rubric from the European ETR guidelines, measuring clarity, coherence, and accessibility.

answer_4.quote: We validated our approach through human evaluation with 10 native French speakers, 7 NLP researchers and 3 linguists, all volunteers, who assessed outputs from the ETR-fr and ETR-fr-politic test sets.
answer_4.guideline: The assessment prioritized the most critical ETR guideline criteria, covering 38 detailed questions, and also evaluated general text generation quality metrics such as Fluency, Grammar/Spelling, Relevance, Textual Coherence, and Overall Perceived Quality.
